## saMBA-pipeline

This repository stores the scripts used to build the **S**outh **A**merican **M**icro**B**iome **A**rchive (saMBA). 

## Important links

* [Documentation](https://github.com/Benjamin-Valderrama/saMBA-pipeline/wiki) of this pipeline.
* [Outputs](https://zenodo.org/records/15050380) generated by the pipeline
* [Preprint](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.04.03.647034v1) introducing saMBA.
* [Code](https://github.com/Benjamin-Valderrama/saMBA-article) used in the preprint.
* [Plans for further development of saMBA](https://benjamin-valderrama.github.io/saMBA.html).
